description: Seven quality gates named by the AI Video Creation Skill Catalog. Each has machine-checkable evidence plus a remediation route. Render-level checks are reported as deferred, never falsely passed.

gates.name: Temporal coherence
gates.remediation: Regenerate or repair only affected shots; add identity/continuity references.

gates.name: Prompt or source fidelity
gates.remediation: Rewrite vague prompts with measurable visual details; recompile.

gates.name: Technical validity
gates.remediation: Correct brief fields against asset-brief-schema.json and the delivery preset.

gates.name: Accessibility
gates.remediation: Fix caption cues with the captions command, then rerun gates.

gates.name: Rights and consent
gates.remediation: Attach rights metadata and record human approval with the approve command.

gates.name: Reproducibility
gates.remediation: Pin seed, provider, model version, and config version in the brief.

gates.name: Handoff readiness
gates.remediation: Run the full plan in execute mode and review the delivery manifest.
